items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the story 'A Letter to God', and answer.

"The clerk at the counter could not stop smiling at the envelope. It was addressed in large, careful letters to someone no postman could ever find. The head of the office took it, read it twice and grew quiet. 'A man who writes like this believes completely,' he said at last. 'We cannot let that belief go unanswered.' By evening the staff had emptied their pockets on his desk."

Answer the following:
(i) How did the head of the office react after reading the letter twice?  (a) He grew quiet and serious  (b) He tore it up  (c) He called the police  (d) He laughed loudly
(ii) What did the staff do by evening?
(iii) Which word best describes the head of the office?  (a) greedy  (b) compassionate  (c) impatient  (d) careless
(iv) How does this passage echo the postmaster in "A Letter to God"?
items.answer: (i) (a) He grew quiet and serious (ii) They gave money from their own pockets to help the writer. (iii) (b) compassionate (iv) Like the postmaster, he respects the writer's faith and collects money so that the faith is not shaken.
items.markingKey: (i) (a) He grew quiet and serious (ii) They gave money from their own pockets to help the writer. (iii) (b) compassionate (iv) Like the postmaster, he respects the writer's faith and collects money so that the faith is not shaken. (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
